name: Derived renewal carries prior NetUnitPrice (no tier recompute) + reset on non-renewal
what_it_tests: A renewal derived line keeps prior NetUnitPrice in the formula instead of recomputing from tier; a non-renewal derived line resets NetUnitPrice to 0 (clearing stale) before the formula re-seeds it
proc_mechanism: Derived Pricing Formula (IF QuoteTypeText='Renewal' then NetUnitPrice); Derived Products - Renewals; Derived Pricing - NetUnitPrice Value Reset (IF Renewal then NetUnitPrice else 0)
expected_behavior: Renewal net = prior NetUnitPrice (tier recompute suppressed); non-renewal NetUnitPrice cleared to 0 then recomputed
test_setup: QuoteTypeText='Renewal' derived line with prior NetUnitPrice; and a New derived line with stale NetUnitPrice
